integrity: The proof reduces maximality to independence of unmatched vertices and then to residual perfect matchings. The checker constructs the graphs and tests maximality directly rather than assuming that reduction.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
The perfect-matching factor is an exact finite sum/recurrence rather than a single closed product for arbitrary part profiles.
The finite verifier covers total order at most eight and is corroborative; the theorem itself is analytic.
One plausible older source on average maximal matchings was bibliographically accessible but not lawfully available in full text during this run.
title: Maximal-matching distribution of complete multipartite graphs
